name: Rustic Montana Furniture
old_description: Your source for authentic, elegantly western furniture.  Made in Montana, you can be assured each piece is created to last a lifetime.  All of our beds are true mortise and tenon construction.   Transform your home with handcrafted authentic western beds, end tables, console tables, dressers, chests, vanities, dining tables, and benches.  Created from barnwood or log, each are handcrafted with form and function in mind.  Our dining tables are all one-of-a-kind created with reclaimed lumber.  For your outdoor space we have rustic swings for two.  Rustic Montana Furniture is certified “Made in Montana”.
about:
Rustic Montana Furniture operates from Philipsburg, Montana, where it has been producing handcrafted western furniture for over two decades. The business is led by Walter Stanghill, who serves as the primary contact for the company. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the firm emphasizes its Montana roots and a commitment to traditional joinery.

The company designs and builds a range of authentic western furniture, including beds, end tables, console tables, dressers, chests, vanities, dining tables, benches, and outdoor swings. All beds feature true mortise-and-tenon construction, and each piece is handcrafted from either barnwood or log materials. Dining tables are made from reclaimed lumber, resulting in one-of-a-kind surfaces. Production takes place entirely in Montana, though the facility size and employee count are not disclosed.

The company serves residential customers seeking elegantly western furnishings, though specific industry segments or commercial clients are not detailed in its public materials. Its certified "Made in Montana" designation underscores a local manufacturing focus.

Rustic Montana Furniture distinguishes itself through its certified "Made in Montana" status, the use of mortise-and-tenon joinery on all beds, and the creation of unique dining tables from reclaimed lumber. The firm states that each piece is created to last a lifetime, reflecting a philosophy of durability and authentic craftsmanship.
